dict.string: Agent Companion uses your camera to scan pairing QR codes from your companion host.
Agent Companion reads your sleep stages, workouts, heart rate, and daily activity from Apple Health so your personal AI agent can understand your physical recovery, workout status, and sleep quality.
Agent Companion connects to Apple Health to synchronize your health telemetry with your personal companion.
Agent Companion needs location access to report your position and trigger companion automations when significant location movements or place arrivals occur.
Agent Companion needs location access even when closed to record significant movements and wake up on arrivals/departures.
Agent Companion needs your location to provide accurate companion updates and map your coordinates.
Agent Companion reads motion activity (stationary, walking, running, driving) so your companion agent knows whether you are moving right now, even when the location fix is a few minutes old.
